defects.claim: z_oi >= 1 selects expansion only (raw OI contraction cannot qualify).
defects.old_evidence: With median -10 MAD 1, delta -8 gives z=1.349 and would pass without raw delta>0; contraction could generate trade despite NO_TRADE claim.
defects.root_cause: V1 frozen rule required only z_oi >= 1 without requiring delta_oi > 0; positive z from negative median/MAD allowed contraction to qualify.
defects.repair: H6 V2 requires BOTH delta_oi > 0 AND robust_z_oi >= 1.0; MAD==0 => NO_TRADE; contraction explicitly NO_TRADE; src/trading_bot/research/h6/feature_engine.py compute_signal implements raw-sign gate; docs and spec freeze example median=-10 MAD=1 delta=-8 -> NO_TRADE.
tests: tests/unit/research/test_oi_full_history_v2_pit.py::test_oi_sign_rule_blocks_contraction_even_when_z_would_pass (median -10 MAD 1 delta -8 => NO_TRADE, delta>0+z<1 NO_TRADE, UP+z>=1 LONG, DOWN+z>=1 SHORT)
